title: The Real Meaning of Chesa Boudin’s Recall

sentences.en: Earlier this week, when San Francisco voters ousted their progressive district attorney, it was seen
sentences.zh: 本周早些时候，旧金山选民罢免了他们的进步派地方检察官，这被视为

sentences.en: as the rejection of an entire class of local prosecutors who are determined to reform the criminal justice system.
sentences.zh: 对一整类决心改革刑事司法系统的地方法方检察官的拒绝。

sentences.en: Today, I spoke with my colleague, Estet Herndon, about what exactly happened in San Francisco and about why the reaction to it may be a major misreading of the moment.
sentences.zh: 今天，我与我的同事埃斯特·埃恩敦谈论了旧金山究竟发生了什么，以及为什么对此事的反应可能是对当下局势的重大误读。

sentences.en: It's Friday, June 10th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 6 月 10 日，星期五。

sentences.en: Estet, what is the context in which Chesa Boudin was first elected the district attorney in San
sentences.zh: 埃斯特，切萨·布丁最初当选旧金山地方检察官时的

sentences.en: Francisco?
sentences.zh: 背景是什么？

sentences.en: What's happening in San Francisco is really a fine point at the end of a much longer story.
sentences.zh: 旧金山发生的事情，其实是一个更长故事末尾的一个焦点。

sentences.en: It really starts years before with a wave of progressive prosecutors who were seeking to reimagine the role of the district attorney and of prosecutors in big American cities.
sentences.zh: 它实际上始于多年前的一股进步派检察官浪潮，他们试图重新构想地方检察官以及美国大城市检察官的角色。

sentences.en: If you think back to the kind of rise of Trump and the grassroots energy that came from the
sentences.zh: 如果你回想一下特朗普的崛起以及由此引发的

sentences.en: Democratic Party in response to that, a lot of the places where progressives and the left were able to get real electoral wins were in these prosecutor district attorney races.
sentences.zh: 民主党基层活力，进步派和左翼能够真正赢得选举的许多地方，正是在这些检察官和地方检察官的竞选中。

sentences.en: Larry Krasner has won the Democratic primary for district attorney.
sentences.zh: 拉里·克拉斯纳赢得了地方检察官民主党初选。

sentences.en: People like Larry Krasner in Philadelphia.
sentences.zh: 就像费城的拉里·克拉斯纳这样的人。

sentences.en: This is a mandate for a movement that is loudly telling government what it wants.
sentences.zh: 这是对一个大声向政府表达诉求的运动的授权。

sentences.en: And what it wants is criminal justice reform.
sentences.zh: 而他们想要的正是刑事司法改革。

sentences.en: The work is just beginning.
sentences.zh: 这项工作才刚刚开始。

sentences.en: Kim Foxx in Chicago.
sentences.zh: 芝加哥的基姆·福克斯。

sentences.en: The need to rebuild a broken criminal justice system here in Cook County is not work that should be taken lightly.
sentences.zh: 在库克县重建一个破碎的刑事司法系统，这项工作绝不能轻视。

sentences.en: Wesley Bell in Missouri.
sentences.zh: 密苏里州的韦斯利·贝尔。

sentences.en: Will soon become the first African American to hold the St. Louis County Prosecutor's PoSt.
sentences.zh: 即将成为第一位担任圣路易斯县检察官职务的非裔美国人。

sentences.en: These were people who had run and won on the idea that the criminal justice system was fundamentally flawed.
sentences.zh: 这些人竞选并获胜的理念是：刑事司法系统存在根本性缺陷。

sentences.en: Using that energy, particularly coming out of the Black Lives Matter movement, to say that
sentences.zh: 他们利用这种活力（特别是来自“黑人的命也是命”运动的活力）提出

sentences.en: the criminal justice system needed a real overall rethinking for the role of prosecutor to be juSt.
sentences.zh: 刑事司法系统需要对检察官的角色进行真正的全面重新思考，以实现公正。

sentences.en: That was really the message they had given to voters and they had latched onto, including in San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 这确实是他们给选民的信息，也是他们紧抓不放的理念，包括在旧金山。

sentences.en: Where Rujing really explicitly ran on those type of promises.
sentences.zh: 鲁京确实明确地带着这类承诺参加了竞选。

sentences.en: We won an election, people.
sentences.zh: 我们赢得了一场选举，各位。

sentences.en: And then won in 2019.
sentences.zh: 并在 2019 年获胜。

sentences.en: And with your help, we're going to end money bail.
sentences.zh: 在你们的帮助下，我们将废除现金保释。

sentences.en: We're going to stop treating mental illness with solitary confinement.
sentences.zh: 我们将停止用单独监禁来治疗精神疾病。

sentences.en: And we're going to start investing in our communities, in all of our communities.
sentences.zh: 我们将开始投资我们的社区，投资于我们所有的社区。

sentences.en: And we're going to do it together.
sentences.zh: 我们将齐心协力完成这一切。

sentences.en: And we're going to do it starting right now.
sentences.zh: 而且我们从现在就开始做。

sentences.en: Thank you, San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，旧金山。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: So all these folks are turning the traditional image of the district attorney, the one you think about when you watch Law and Order as the tough as nails.
sentences.zh: 所以所有这些人都颠覆了地方检察官的传统形象——也就是你看《法律与秩序》时想到的那种铁腕形象。

sentences.en: How many years can we get against this fellow?
sentences.zh: 我们能对这家伙判多少年监禁？

sentences.en: Like, they're just turning that on its head.
sentences.zh: 比如，他们彻底颠覆了这一点。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I think that that was really emblematic of a Democratic Party that was largely rethinking its relationship to criminal justice and public safety.
sentences.zh: 我认为这真正体现了一个民主党，该党在很大程度上正在重新思考其与刑事司法和公共安全的关系。

sentences.en: If we think back to the last presidential primary, yeah, candidates all across the kind of ideological spectrum really embraced that message.
sentences.zh: 如果我们回想一下上一次总统初选，是的，各种意识形态谱系的候选人都真正接受了这一信息。

sentences.en: It wasn't just that progressive prosecutors were winning their own races.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是进步派检察官赢得了他们自己的竞选。

sentences.en: It's that they were winning the general argument among Democrats about how they should be talking
sentences.zh: 而是他们在民主党内部关于如何讨论

sentences.en: about criminal justice and public safety, that this was actually what people wanted.
sentences.zh: 刑事司法和公共安全的大辩论中赢得了共识，这正是人们想要的。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So tell us about Boudin.
sentences.zh: 那么给我们讲讲布丁吧。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think that it's fair to say that Boudin is someone who fits the mold of San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为可以公平地说，布丁非常符合旧金山的模子。

sentences.en: If you were to close your eyes and draw up the bio of an archetype of a San Francisco progressive prosecutor, it would be someone with this history.
sentences.zh: 如果你闭上眼睛，勾勒出一个旧金山进步派检察官代表人物的履历，就会是拥有这样历史的人。

sentences.en: Boudin's parents were actually members of the notorious 60s leftist group, the Weather Underground.
sentences.zh: 布丁的父母实际上是 60 年代臭名昭著的左翼组织“地下气象员”的成员。

sentences.en: And they spent decades in prison after being convicted as part of the group's violent activities.
sentences.zh: 他们因参与该组织的暴力活动而被定罪，并在监狱里度过了几十年。

sentences.en: He was raised in Chicago with other members of leftist radical politics royalty, frankly.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，他在芝加哥长大，身边都是左翼激进政治权贵圈的其他成员。

sentences.en: And that is really the tradition in which he comes from.
sentences.zh: 这确实是他出身的传统。

sentences.en: Spent time in Venezuela, was a Rhodes Scholar.
sentences.zh: 他在委内瑞拉呆过，曾是罗德学者。

sentences.en: And so he comes to San Francisco with that in mind.
sentences.zh: 因此，他带着这种观念来到了旧金山。

sentences.en: And he runs really putting those academic ideological things he'd been thinking about into very specific
sentences.zh: 他在竞选时，确实将他一直在思考的那些学术和意识形态的东西转化为非常具体的

sentences.en: language, kind of owns what progressive prosecutors would call a decarceration platform, and is
sentences.zh: 语言，拥有所谓进步派检察官所称的“去监禁化”纲领，并

sentences.en: telling voters that with him as district attorney, he won't help ICE with raids and arrests of undocumented immigrants, that they would reevaluate wrongful convictions on crimes.
sentences.zh: 告诉选民，有他当地方检察官，他不会协助移民和海关执法局（ICE）对无证移民进行突袭和逮捕，他们将重新评估对犯罪的有罪判决。

sentences.en: That he was going to focus on reducing cash bail and other issues that have really become the order of the day for those progressive prosecutors across the country.
sentences.zh: 他将专注于减少现金保释以及其他真正成为全国各地进步派检察官当务之急的问题。

sentences.en: So his election in San Francisco, which comes after these other candidates you mentioned,
sentences.zh: 因此，他在旧金山的当选，发生在您提到的其他候选人之后，

sentences.en: feels like the capstone to this wave of progressive prosecutors taking over these big jobs in
sentences.zh: 感觉像是这股进步派检察官浪潮入主美国大城市重要

sentences.en: American cities.
sentences.zh: 职务的最高峰。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think you can say that.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想你可以这么说。

sentences.en: But when you get to that later wave of prosecutors elected, people like Boudin, they're coming to
sentences.zh: 但当你到了后来那一批当选的检察官时，比如布丁，他们是在一个

sentences.en: power in a changed political environment, much different than that grassroots Trump resistance energy.
sentences.zh: 变了的政治环境中掌权的，与当年特朗普草根抵抗运动的活力大不相同。

sentences.en: And it's pretty clear that a backlash, at least the headwinds of a backlash, were really just starting to form.
sentences.zh: 很明显，一场反弹（至少是反弹的逆风）才刚刚开始形成。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And what does that backlash look like in San Francisco?
sentences.zh: 这种反弹在旧金山是什么样的？

sentences.en: Within the first month of Boudin's tenure, he's really put under pressure by a familiar opponent for these progressive prosecutors, the police union.
sentences.zh: 在布丁任职的第一个月内，他就受到了进步派检察官的老对手——警察工会的巨大压力。

sentences.en: He had decided not to prosecute a man who was seen on camera hitting a police officer with a liquor bottle.
sentences.zh: 他决定不 prosecute（起诉）一名在镜头前用酒瓶击打警察的男子。

sentences.en: Now, that man was also shot by the police officer and was a really contentious overall case.
sentences.zh: 现在，那名男子也被警察枪击了，总体而言这是一起极具争议的案件。

sentences.en: But in choosing not to charge the man initially with hitting the police officer with a liquor
sentences.zh: 但在选择最初不以用酒瓶袭击警察的罪名起诉

sentences.en: bottle, you had the union come out early and say that Boudin was giving criminals a green light to attack officers.
sentences.zh: 那名男子时，工会很早就站出来说，布丁是在给犯罪分子袭击警察开绿灯。

sentences.en: And so they eventually reversed that decision to give the man some charges later.
sentences.zh: 因此他们最终推翻了这一决定，稍后对该男子提出了一些指控。

sentences.en: But it was the first initial drawing of lines between a police union that was actively pushing back against the newly elected district attorney.
sentences.zh: 但这标志着警察工会与积极反击新任地方检察官的势力之间首次划清了界限。

sentences.en: And I think he ends up having to deal with really visible incidents of crime.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为他最终不得不处理非常显眼的犯罪事件。

sentences.en: They broke in and stole a bunch of stuff.
sentences.zh: 他们破门而入，偷了一堆东西。

sentences.en: And, you know, insurance doesn't cover possessions, really.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，保险其实不赔偿个人财物。

sentences.en: The grocery store across from my house, the windows have been broken at least twice.
sentences.zh: 我家对面的杂货店，窗户已经被砸了至少两次。

sentences.en: And now it's boarded up.
sentences.zh: 现在它已经被木板封起来了。

sentences.en: Car thefts have been going up.
sentences.zh: 汽车盗窃案一直在上升。

sentences.en: The shattered car safety glass around the city is known as San Francisco snow.
sentences.zh: 城市周围破碎的汽车安全玻璃被称为“旧金山雪”。

sentences.en: So far this year, there have been 700 more car break-ins than last year.
sentences.zh: 今年到目前为止，汽车砸窗盗窃案比去年增加了 700 起。

sentences.en: Burglaries have been going up in the city.
sentences.zh: 市内的入室盗窃案一直在增加。

sentences.en: Crime and looting are out of control.
sentences.zh: 犯罪和打砸抢已经失控。

sentences.en: There were rampant shoplifting at downtown San Francisco pharmacies and grocery stores.
sentences.zh: 旧金山市中心的药店和杂货店发生了猖獗的入室盗窃。

sentences.en: Just this past weekend, thieves ransacked retail stores, pharmacies, luxury shops.
sentences.zh: 就在刚过去的这个周末，小偷洗劫了零售店、药店、奢侈品店。

sentences.en: And there was just some quality of life concerns that were piling up in both media and kind of taking off online.
sentences.zh: 而且一些生活质量方面的问题越积越多，既出现在媒体上，也在网络上迅速发酵。

sentences.en: For the last two weeks, parents and school leaders have been trying to get help with a homeless encampment right next to their school.
sentences.zh: 在过去的两周里，家长和学校领导一直试图寻求帮助，解决学校旁边的一个无家可归者营地问题。

sentences.en: And, and I think principally...
sentences.zh: 而且，我认为主要是……

sentences.en: San Francisco police last month revealed hate crimes targeting Asians exploded more than 500% in 2021.
sentences.zh: 旧金山警方上个月透露，针对亚裔的仇恨犯罪在 2021 年激增了 500% 以上。

sentences.en: He's dealing with a real increase of Asian American hate crimes.
sentences.zh: 他正在应对亚裔美国人仇恨犯罪的真实增加。

sentences.en: The Visha Ratnipakti case in particular, where an 84-year-old Thai grandfather was shoved to the ground and killed in January of this year.
sentences.zh: 特别是维沙·拉特尼帕蒂（Visha Ratnipakti）案，今年 1 月，一名 84 岁的泰国祖父被推倒在地并身亡。

sentences.en: That really kind of inflamed tensions in the city.
sentences.zh: 这确实在某种程度上加剧了市内的紧张局势。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And how does Boudin respond to these trend lines that seem to be going, in many cases, in the wrong direction?
sentences.zh: 布丁如何回应这些在许多情况下似乎朝着错误方向发展的趋势线？

sentences.en: Boudin says that he is going to follow through that playbook in which he ran on, which is not going to prioritize the tough-on crime or try to block people away forever.
sentences.zh: 布丁表示，他将贯彻他竞选时的执政方针，也就是不会将“对犯罪采取强硬态度”放在首位，也不会试图把人们永远关在监狱里。

sentences.en: But specifically, in the incident of the man who was killed, Boudin said some things that got him in trouble.
sentences.zh: 但具体在那起命案中，布丁说了一些给他带来麻烦的话。

sentences.en: Boudin was quoted in the New York Times as saying Watson was having some sort of temper tantrum,
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》援引布丁的话说，沃森当时在发某种脾气，

sentences.en: a term more often used to describe toddlers that doesn't sit well with Visha's family.
sentences.zh: 这是一个更常用来形容幼儿的词，这让维沙的家人感到非常不满。

sentences.en: He responded by explaining some of the actions of the attacker as a temper tantrum.
sentences.zh: 他通过将袭击者的某些行为解释为“发脾气”来进行回应。

sentences.en: Hearing this excuse of hissy fit is just, it's really upsetting.
sentences.zh: 听到这种把“大发雷霆”当借口的说法，真的是，太令人心烦了。

sentences.en: The victim's family went to local media and talked about how that showed that Boudin really
sentences.zh: 受害者的家属去了当地媒体，谈到这表明布丁根本

sentences.en: didn't understand the reality of violence and the deep-rootedness of the hatred that those communities are up againSt.
sentences.zh: 不理解暴力的现实，以及这些社区所面对的仇恨的根深蒂固。

sentences.en: It was a criticism of both tone and policy at the same time.
sentences.zh: 这是对语气和政策的同时批评。

sentences.en: And that's really what his critics started hammering on.
sentences.zh: 这正是他的批评者们开始大加挞伐的地方。

sentences.en: That includes some of his political critics also.
sentences.zh: 这也包括他的一些政治批评者。

sentences.en: The mayor of San Francisco, London Breed, talked about Boudin and said that his policies were out of touch with what the city needed.
sentences.zh: 旧金山市长伦敦·布里德谈到布丁时说，他的政策与城市的需求脱节。

sentences.en: I mean, that's a pretty rare thing to happen on local levels, is for the mayor to be taking
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在地方层面上发生这种情况相当罕见，即市长对在职地方检察官采取立场，而他们理论上应该在公共安全问题上协同工作。

sentences.en: a stance against the active district attorney, who are theoretically working in tandem on public safety.
sentences.zh: 而且在这个案例中，两人都是民主党人。

sentences.en: And in this case, are both Democrats.
sentences.zh: 而且在这个案例中，两人都是民主党人。

sentences.en: And in this case, are both Democrats.
sentences.zh: 而且在这个案例中，两人都是民主党人。

sentences.en: Importantly, in these big cities, are largely often both Democrats.
sentences.zh: 重要的是，在这些大城市里，往往很大程度上两人都是民主党人。

sentences.en: And I think that really shows that the mayor, who is hearing from a different kind of voting
sentences.zh: 我认为这真正表明，倾听不同选民群体声音的市长，

sentences.en: base, is kind of recognizing that backlash and has, frankly, started increasingly throwing
sentences.zh: 某种程度上意识到了这种反弹，并且坦白说，开始越来越多地把布丁扔给群狼，

sentences.en: Boudin out to the wolves, saying, you know, that's his stuff, not mine.
sentences.zh: 说，你知道的，那是他的事，不是我的。

sentences.en: And so that tension kind of builds to a recall effort of Boudin.
sentences.zh: 因此，这种紧张局势最终演变成了针对布丁的罢免运动。

sentences.en: Now, this is somewhat specific to California because California has these kind of like quirky state laws that allows a little more easily for politicians to be recalled.
sentences.zh: 现在，这在一定程度上是加州特有的，因为加州有一些奇特的州法律，使得罢免政治人物变得更容易一些。

sentences.en: Remember, the governor just survived a recall effort recently.
sentences.zh: 记住，州长最近刚刚挺过了一场罢免运动。

sentences.en: And so there are signatures that are passed around in San Francisco, and enough folks sign on where Boudin has to face a recall election.
sentences.zh: 因此，请愿签名在旧金山传阅，当有足够多的人签名时，布丁就不得不面对一场罢免选举。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And as this recall election gets underway, Ested, how much are people talking about and analyzing
sentences.zh: 随着这场罢免选举的展开，埃斯特，人们在多大程度上讨论和分析

sentences.en: the question of whether Boudin's policies are really responsible for things like robberies going up, and shoplifting going up, and hate crimes against Asian Americans?
sentences.zh: 这样问题：布丁的政策是否真的要为抢劫案增加、入室盗窃增加以及针对亚裔美国人的仇恨犯罪负责？

sentences.en: This is a question that the progressive prosecutors all across the country have to answer all the time.
sentences.zh: 这是全国各地的进步派检察官必须一直回答的问题。

sentences.en: They feel like it is not proven.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得这并没有被证实。

sentences.en: And we should say, journalistically, we do not really have a causal stat to show that the
sentences.zh: 我们应该从新闻角度说明，我们确实没有因果统计数据来表明，

sentences.en: policies of progressives are directly responsible for increases in crime and in violent crime.
sentences.zh: 进步派的政策直接导致了犯罪和暴力犯罪的增加。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: These things were happening in places that had not elected these type of prosecutors.
sentences.zh: 这些事情也发生在没有选举这类检察官的地方。

sentences.en: And so there was not a one-to-one factual basis to say that the things that were happening
sentences.zh: 因此，并没有一个一比一的事实基础来断言，旧金山发生的事情

sentences.en: in San Francisco was the fault of the election of Boudin, and that's what led to the recall election.
sentences.zh: 是选举布丁的过错，而这正是导致罢免选举的原因。

sentences.en: But we know that politics, I think I said this on the Daily before, politics isn't debate class.
sentences.zh: 但我们知道政治——我想我以前在《每日新闻》里说过这个——政治不是辩论课。

sentences.en: Like, it is not actually just about what is factually related, but how people feel things are related.
sentences.zh: 比如，它其实不仅仅关乎事实上有何关联，还关乎人们觉得它们有何关联。

sentences.en: And it became very clear that the recall vote was wrapping in all of those issues into this one election.
sentences.zh: 而且很明显，罢免投票将所有这些问题都卷入了这场选举之中。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And of course, as we now know, Boudin loses that recall election decisively.
sentences.zh: 当然，正如我们现在所知，布丁在那场罢免选举中惨败。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It was about a 60 to 40 margin.
sentences.zh: 比例大约是 60 对 40。

sentences.en: And that's a pretty clear electoral rebuke, even in a low-turnout election.
sentences.zh: 这是一个相当清晰的选举惩罚，即使在投票率较低的选举中也是如此。

sentences.en: For Boudin, you know, it also is pretty damning on where this came from.
sentences.zh: 对布丁来说，你知道，这也是一个相当确凿的证据，说明这东西是从哪来的。

sentences.en: You know, this was a rejection that was driven by the large Asian population of San Francisco that was across economic scale, if you look at neighborhoods, and says that there was
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是一次遭到旧金山庞大亚裔人口抵制的行动，这种抵制跨越了经济阶层，如果你看看各个社区就会发现，

sentences.en: a real coalition of folks who were dissatisfied with these policies.
sentences.zh: 这实际上是一个由对这些政策感到不满的人组成的联盟。

sentences.en: And so what is the reaction to this 60-40, clear-as-day political rejection of Boudin?
sentences.zh: 那么，对于这场60比40、对布丁明显的政治驱逐，人们作何反应？

sentences.en: Among progressives, it is a real recognition that they cannot dismiss the criticism being levied by their opponents.
sentences.zh: 在进步派内部，人们真正认识到，他们无法无视对手提出的批评。

sentences.en: That it has taken root, and they can't deny that.
sentences.zh: 这种批评已经扎根，他们无法否认这一点。

sentences.en: Among some, we should say.
sentences.zh: 当然，这只是对某些人而言。

sentences.en: But I think really, among media and the kind of national politics, there's a real rush to
sentences.zh: 但我认为，在媒体和国家政治层面，确实有一股急于……的冲动

sentences.en: say that Democrats are retreating from criminal justice reform, are turning their back on some
sentences.zh: 声称民主党人正在从刑事司法改革中退缩，正在背弃我们在2020年“黑人的命也是命”运动中听到的一些坚定信念，声称选民是在向民主党人传递一个信息，即他们不想要那些可能

sentences.en: of the affirmations we heard in the kind of Black Lives Matter moment in 2020, that voters were sending a message to Democrats saying that they don't want policies that could be
sentences.zh: 被认为是所谓“对犯罪态度软弱”的政策。

sentences.en: considered, quote-unquote, lenient on crime.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The thinking is if Democrats in the country's most progressive city are tossing out their
sentences.zh: 他们的想法是，如果这个国家最进步的城市的民主党人都在抛弃他们

sentences.en: most progressive district attorney, that it's kind of game over for this kind of prosecutor everywhere.
sentences.zh: 最进步的地区检察官，那这就意味着这种检察官在各地都彻底完蛋了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The thought was, if San Francisco is rejecting its beacon of progressives, then the country must be.
sentences.zh: 大家的想法是，如果连旧金山都在排斥其进步主义的灯塔，那么整个国家也一定在排斥。

sentences.en: But in my reporting and in talking with these people, drawing that one-to-one calls a relationship,
sentences.zh: 但在我的报道中，在与这些人交谈时，将这两者直接画等号——

sentences.en: that progressive policies meant crime went up, and thus people are retreating from criminal justice reform, it's just too simple of a connection.
sentences.zh: 即进步政策导致犯罪率上升，因此人们正在从刑事司法改革中退缩——这种联系实在太简单化了。

sentences.en: And the reality is, as it often is in politics, more nuanced and more complicated.
sentences.zh: 而现实是，正如政治中常见的那样，要微妙得多，也复杂得多。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一个专注于热爱设计及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you.
sentences.zh: 甚至在我还在黑胶唱片时代的光盘骑师夜总会打碟的时候，你每天晚上都要带着你最珍爱的300件宝贝去上班。

sentences.en: And you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把打碟台变成了一个充满生机的快闪博物馆，里面摆满了精美的、拥有50年历史的工艺品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你喜爱的播客平台上收听由爱彼呈现的《重构者》。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡，会怎么样呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》应用程序，并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So, Ested, explain, as you started to before the break, why Chesa Boudin's recall is not necessarily meaning what people might think that it means.
sentences.zh: 那么，埃斯特德，请解释一下，正如你在中场休息前开始说的那样，为什么切萨·布丁被罢免并不一定意味着人们所想象的那样。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: This wasn't the first time a progressive prosecutor has faced real pressure on these type of issues.
sentences.zh: 这并不是进步派检察官第一次在这些类型的问题上面临真正的压力。

sentences.en: And some of them have been successful in winning re-election in the face of that.
sentences.zh: 其中一些人在面对这种压力时成功赢得了连任。

sentences.en: When we look at Larry Krasner in Philadelphia, he faced a well-funded challenger who was hitting
sentences.zh: 当我们看看费城的拉里·克拉斯纳时，他面临着一个资金充足的挑战者，后者频频在

sentences.en: on these issues, talking about rising crime rates and saying that his policies were not deterring criminals.
sentences.zh: 这些问题上发难，谈论不断上升的犯罪率，并称他的政策未能震慑罪犯。

sentences.en: And Krasner was successful in getting re-elected.
sentences.zh: 而克拉斯纳成功再次当选。

sentences.en: You had Kim Foxx in Illinois and Cook County, a place that obviously has its real issues with public safety and crime.
sentences.zh: 还有伊利诺伊州和库克郡的金·福克斯，这个地方显然在公共安全和犯罪问题上有其真正的问题。

sentences.en: Someone who won re-election even when people were hitting her on those type of issues.
sentences.zh: 即使人们在这些类型的问题上攻击她，她依然赢得了连任。

sentences.en: So I think that we have to think of what happened in San Francisco as one plot point out of many,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，我们必须将旧金山发生的事情看作众多情节中的一个切入点，

sentences.en: rather than just a singular story that says, because Boudin was recalled, people don't like criminal justice reform.
sentences.zh: 而不是单一的故事，不能简单地认为因为布丁被罢免了，人们就不喜欢刑事司法改革。

sentences.en: And I said, why did the district attorneys you just mentioned win those recent races, do you think?
sentences.zh: 我问，你认为你刚才提到的那些地区检察官为什么能赢得最近的这些竞选？

sentences.en: When you talk to people in those cities, and I've talked to both of those district attorneys themselves, they really think that they win by basically doing good politics, that they
sentences.zh: 当你与那些城市的民众交谈时，我也和这两位地区检察官本人谈过，他们确实认为自己取胜是因为基本上做好了政治工作，他们

sentences.en: recognize the disconnect between progressive activists and some of their constituents, and they changed or shifted or emphasized different portions of their message to do that.
sentences.zh: 认识到了进步派积极分子与他们的一些选民之间的脱节，为此他们改变、转变或强调了他们传达的信息的不同部分。

sentences.en: I mean, it's important to remember that it's not as if progressive prosecutors think crime doesn't matter.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，记住这一点很重要，进步派检察官并不是觉得犯罪不重要。

sentences.en: They just think they have a different method of approaching public safety.
sentences.zh: 他们只是觉得他们有一套不同的方法来处理公共安全问题。

sentences.en: I think we also have to be clear that we're talking about cities with different racial makeups.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们还必须明确，我们讨论的是具有不同种族构成的小镇。

sentences.en: And specifically, Philadelphia and Chicago have much larger Black populations than San Francisco does.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，费城和芝加哥的黑人人口比旧金山要多得多。

sentences.en: And if you talk to anyone across the criminal justice kind of community, or even these prosecutors
sentences.zh: 如果你与刑事司法领域的任何人交谈，甚至与这些检察官

sentences.en: themselves, they will say how Black communities have been talking about the issue of criminal
sentences.zh: 本人交谈，他们都会说黑人社区在这些城市里长期以来一直在谈论刑事

sentences.en: justice reform for a long time in these cities, and it's actually really taken root, the reform in a different way.
sentences.zh: 司法改革问题，而且改革实际上已经真正扎根，并以一种不同的方式推进。

sentences.en: You know, we know that the Chicagos and Philadelphias of the world experienced the real brunt of the
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们知道芝加哥和费城这样的城市承受了90年代严厉打击犯罪和

sentences.en: 90s ramp-up of tough-on-crime and incarceration.
sentences.zh: 大规模监禁政策的真正沉重打击。

sentences.en: And that legacy is still really palpable there.
sentences.zh: 这种历史遗产在那里仍然切实存在。

sentences.en: It's not to say that that's not true in San Francisco, but you have a different voting block set.
sentences.zh: 这并不是说在旧金山情况就不是这样，但你的选民基础不同。

sentences.en: You have much more affluent white liberals.
sentences.zh: 你有更多富裕的白人自由派。

sentences.en: You have a much larger Asian electorate.
sentences.zh: 你有规模大得多的亚裔选民群体。

sentences.en: And it's not to say that those communities don't care about criminal justice reform, but specifically when we're talking about how Krasner and Fox leaned on those relationships
sentences.zh: 这并不是说这些社区不关心刑事司法改革，但具体到克拉斯纳和福克斯如何利用这些关系

sentences.en: to help their re-election, that wasn't necessarily an option that exists in the same way for Boudin
sentences.zh: 来帮助他们连任时，这对于旧金山的布丁来说

sentences.en: in San Francisco, and the base is that it's a different city with a different local complexion.
sentences.zh: 不一定是以同样的方式存在的选项，其根本在于这是一个具有不同地方风貌的不同城市。

sentences.en: So, in reality, Boudin was in a unique situation, and perhaps he was more the exception in many
sentences.zh: 所以，在现实中，布丁处于一种独特的境地，当我们思考美国进步派地区检察官的现状时，

sentences.en: different ways than he was any kind of rule when we think about the state of the progressive district attorney in the United States.
sentences.zh: 在许多方面，他或许更像是特例，而不是什么普遍规律。

sentences.en: But to the degree that the narrative of the Boudin recall as emblematic of where American politics is, even if it's not quite right, what is the impact of that perception?
sentences.zh: 但就罢免布丁的叙事作为美国政治现状的象征而言，即使这种看法不完全准确，这种看法的深远影响又是什么呢？

sentences.en: The impact is politics.
sentences.zh: 这种影响就是政治。

sentences.en: In a midterm election year, you have both parties really seeking a message that's going to stick.
sentences.zh: 在期中选举年，两党都在极力寻找一个能引起共鸣的口号。

sentences.en: And Republicans have zeroed in on crime and public safety as a winning one.
sentences.zh: 而共和党人则把犯罪和公共安全锁定为一个能够取胜的议题。

sentences.en: And they have done that by really drawing a conflation between three different types of liberals.
sentences.zh: 他们通过将三种不同类型的自由派混为一谈来做到这一点。

sentences.en: Progressive activists who embraced defunding police and structural change.
sentences.zh: 支持削减警察经费和结构性变革的进步派激进分子。

sentences.en: Progressive prosecutors who came to power from those communities, but talk a little differently.
sentences.zh: 从这些社区崛起、但说话方式略有不同的进步派检察官。

sentences.en: And you have the institutional Democratic Party, right, led by Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 还有以乔·拜登为首的建制派民主党，对吧？

sentences.en: And what Republicans are going to try to do is really flatten all three of those and say
sentences.zh: 而共和党人将要尝试做的是，把这三者完全混为一谈，并声称

sentences.en: that the reason to reject Joe Biden and the congressional Democrats running is because they have gone too far to the left.
sentences.zh: 之所以要拒绝乔·拜登和参选的国会民主党人，是因为他们向左走得太远了。

sentences.en: And the example you can use for that are these scary progressive prosecutors and their scary progressive language.
sentences.zh: 你可以用来举例说明这一点的事例，就是这些可怕的进步派检察官和他们可怕的进步主义言论。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So when they're telling Boudin and his policies are the same as Joe Biden in the White House,
sentences.zh: 所以，当他们说布丁及其政策与白宫里的乔·拜登如出一辙时——

sentences.en: even though Joe Biden and Boudin probably couldn't be further apart on criminal justice within the
sentences.zh: 尽管在民主党内部，乔·拜登和布丁在刑事司法问题上的观点可能大相径庭，

sentences.en: Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 甚至可以说是风马牛不相及。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: I mean, we're talking about a Joe Biden who passed the 90s crime bills, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们说的是通过了90年代犯罪法案的乔·拜登，对吧？

sentences.en: We're talking about Joe Biden who has made his legacy around these things, who's really an architect of the thing that Chesa Boudin is running againSt.
sentences.zh: 我们说的是围绕这些事情建立政治遗产的乔·拜登，他实际上正是切萨·布丁所反对的那个事物的缔造者。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But still, in this moment, and with Boudin as the party leader, what Republicans are going to do is use the D next to both of those names to really play up the fear.
sentences.zh: 但即便如此，在这个时刻，随着布丁被当作该党的反面典型，共和党人要做的是利用这两个名字后面的“D”（民主党标签）来大肆渲染恐惧。

sentences.en: And because that is so clear that that is going to be a line of Republican attack, it has also impacted Democrats too.
sentences.zh: 而且由于这显然将成为共和党攻击的一条主线，它也对民主党产生了影响。

sentences.en: How?
sentences.zh: 如何影响？

sentences.en: It's kind of funny because it's like a prevent defense, if we think in the NFL terms, right?
sentences.zh: 这有点搞笑，因为如果我们用美式橄榄球术语来思考的话，这就像是防守反击战术，对吧？

sentences.en: Because you know that the other side is going to do something dramatic.
sentences.zh: 因为你知道对方要做一些戏剧化的举动。

sentences.en: You self-correct to try to stop that impact from happening.
sentences.zh: 你进行自我修正，试图阻止这种冲击发生。

sentences.en: And so you have Joe Biden in major speeches kind of consistently hammering that he wants to fund the police, not defund the police, right?
sentences.zh: 因此，乔·拜登在重要演讲中不断强调他希望资助警察，而不是削减警察经费，对吧？

sentences.en: You have the kind of prominent figures in the Democratic Party right now embracing New
sentences.zh: 你现在可以看到，民主党内的知名领袖开始拥抱

sentences.en: York City's mayor, Eric Adams, as a kind of avatar of a different type of criminal justice
sentences.zh: 纽约市长埃里克·亚当斯，将其视为一种不同类型的刑事司法

sentences.en: reform, one that embraces cops, one that wants to increase police funding even while talking alongside the need for criminal justice reform issues.
sentences.zh: 改革的化身——一种拥抱警察、希望增加警察经费，同时又承认需要解决刑事司法改革问题的化身。

sentences.en: And the way that we began this by saying that progressive prosecutors have won the argument
